title: He Mows With His Eyes SHUT 🌿
description:
Never look at the neighbor's lawn while his mower's running. Not even through the blinds. He only mows at three in the morning, and his grass is the greenest on the street.

My dad has fought that lawn for ten years, and ours has one bald spot he can't fix. This Friday he set an alarm to catch him.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment PEEK if you would have looked.
